_comment: Perturbation-sweep protocol (T04, plan 6.3), filled with the paper values recovered in T03 (pncbf-v2-recover) and the T04 reconciliation. Evidence per value in _evidence and experiments/pncbf/reports/T04.md. Override any value on the run_eval_sweep.py command line.

_evidence.nr_envs: plan 6.3 (paper: 1 CPU env x 10 episodes per pkl, T03_T05.md F10)
_evidence.episode_length_in_seconds: OPEN. plan 6.3 says 10 s; paper eval length not recorded; recover's return calibration suggests ~4 s (paper return 7.85 / ~0.04 per step). CPU env default 20 s (plots:mujoco/default_config.py:175)
_evidence.terrains: figure column titles (plot_line_plot_one_figure.py:46-51); CPU env default hfield_diverse (mujoco/default_config.py:164); training on plane (wandb args, INDEX.md)
_evidence.modes: plan 6.2: A for all methods, B for shield methods (B is the paper setting: eval_safety_True pkls)
_evidence.sampling_probs: x ticks of paper Fig. 2 (recover, paper_curves.csv / T03_T05.md F10)
_evidence.eval_seeds: paper eval seeds not recoverable (pkls missing); one fixed seed shared by all methods
_evidence.noise_std: plots:ncbf_ppo/flax/ppo.py:951-952 (N(0,1) * if_sampling on the processed action); = 6-16 % of the Go2 action range, not 50 % (plan 6.3)
_evidence.noise_point: plots:ncbf_ppo/flax/ppo.py:951-955 (noise added before the shield call)
_evidence.push_scale: paper appendix 'we double the magnitude' (recover); not in code
_evidence.push_scale_joints: assumption shared with recover's paper_eval_sweep.sh (all four perturbation bounds x2); exact parameter set not recoverable
_evidence.push_impl: env = the env's own push (same as paper CPU env and training); eval_loop is ~60x cheaper per push point (see T04.md section 5)
_evidence.background_push_prob: -1 = env config 0.002, on during the action-noise suites as in the paper CPU env (mujoco/default_config.py:75, eval_mode forced True at environment.py:185)
_evidence.success_threshold_steps: write_evaluation_to_csv.py:261 (finished = length >= 250); primary success = not terminated within the horizon
_evidence.initial_command_zero_prob: paper eval ran 10 episodes in sequence per process and the command persists across resets (resampled w.p. 0.002/step, 0 at the first reset): with 10 s episodes P(episode starts at 0) ~ (1 + e^-1 + e^-2 + ...)/10 ~ 0.16. 0.0 = every episode starts with a random command, 1.0 = env default (all 0)
_evidence.paper_shield: cpu_test = shield of the paper's CPU eval (plots:ncbf_ppo/flax/ncbf.py make_get_safe_action_q, last_state = current obs at flax/ppo.py:1001); only used for paper-code (ncbf-q) checkpoints on branch pncbf-v2-eval-paper
_evidence.paper_checkpoint_env_args: see checkpoints_paper_example.json: ncbf_use_policy_observations=True, env_curriculum_level_success_episode_return=8, command max_velocity_per_m_factor=2.0, clip_max_velocity=2.0 (wandb args of the ncbf-q-safe runs, INDEX.md)
